correctness.rationale: The exact source score is positive constant C_d times Gamma ratio B(p) divided by two evaluation rounds when 2<=p<=c or ceil(p/c)+1 beyond, with a special 2/3 factor for p=1. The integral L(s)=d(log B)/ds=int_0^∞ e^(-su)/(1+e^-u)du is positive and strictly <1/[2(s−1)] for s>1. Hence H_c(s)=B(s)/(s+c) strictly decreases for s>=c+2, while Gamma recurrence gives exact equality H_c(c+2)=H_c(c). Since B(p) strictly increases, each partially filled batch is strictly dominated by its full batch; for k>=2, H_c(kc)<=H_c(c+2)=H_c(c), equality at k=2,c=2 only. p=1 and c=1 bounds compare elementary B(1),B(2),B(3) with 3<π<4, all d cases included. Independent exhaustive bounded score comparison d<=150,c<=64 matched all classifications, not used as all-integer proof.
